identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a premium, high-trust dental clinic template that feels human, professional, and distinct.

theme.strategy: Medical Clean - High white space, strong typography, subtle blue/teal accents.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, hero text, and card headings. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraph text, labels, and descriptions. Tracking normal.

layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing. Gap-8 to Gap-12 for grids.
layout_strategies.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Services. Asymmetric split for Hero.
layout_strategies.mobile_rules: Stack all grids to col-1. Images max-h-[60vh]. Touch targets min 44px.

HeroSection.instructions: Split layout. Left: High-impact Headline + Subtext + Booking CTA. Right: Large engaging image with a 'floating' trust badge (e.g., '500+ Happy Patients') overlapping the corner. No full-width background images.

ServicesGrid.instructions: Use the Bento Grid strategy. Mix large cards (Implants/Cosmetic) with smaller cards (Cleaning/Whitening). Use icons + short descriptions. Hover effect: Subtle lift and border color change.

BookingDialog.instructions: Use Shadcn Dialog. Inside: A multi-step form or a clean vertical form. Fields: Name, Phone, Email, Service Type (Select), Preferred Date, Time Slot. Submit to backend.

Testimonials.instructions: Use Shadcn Carousel. Clean cards with 5 stars (gold color), quote text, and patient name. Minimalist design.

TeamSection.instructions: Grid of doctor profiles. Image + Name + Specialty. Clean, simple cards.

BeforeAfter.instructions: Interactive slider comparison if possible, or side-by-side cards. Show transformational results.

Navbar.instructions: Sticky. White background with shadow-sm. Logo left, Links center (hidden mobile), 'Book Now' Button right (Teal). Mobile Menu (Sheet).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky nav or overlays. backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for interactive elements. shadow-md for floating elements.

universal_guidelines: Do not use center text alignment for long paragraphs.
Use DM Sans for all Body text.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Ensure 3:1 contrast ratio for all text.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium Dental Clinic Template. Follow the JSON structure strictly. Create the components in the specified paths. Ensure the 'BookingDialog' connects to a functional backend endpoint (mocked or real). Use the provided Unsplash URLs for placeholders. Do not ask clarifying questions.
